blocks.text: GENERAL SANTOS CITY — Two buildings at Mindanao State University-General Santos City that were badly damaged by the magnitude 7.8 earthquake in June have been repaired and are now being used, Public Works and Highways Secretary Vince Dizon said Monday. Dizon inspected the university’s Graduate School and Infirmary Building, which he said were among the facilities hardest hit by the powerful earthquake on June 8. Both buildings have since been rehabilitated and are now being used by students and faculty.
